answer: Look-alike keys still pour from one control room. Admission is a 17-hour night watch at cairn 2 of the north horizon berm: the claimant seats a 4.3 g ivory wedge in a sealed crystal gnomon, then records shadow length every 10 minutes against a published solar ephemeris hash. Bond is 41 POA for 7 days. Three clerks re-weigh the wedge to 0.04 g, replay the hash, and reject any two shadow series whose Fréchet distance is under 1.9 cm. A second key that reuses a wedge serial or skips more than four lengths forfeits 53% of the bond and idles that cairn for 6 epochs.
